elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "the amounts paid or payable by that Party under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — 'amounts' rather than fees, and an event anchor rather than the claim

elements.element: Greater-of structure and mutuality of the cap
elements.evidence: "the total aggregate liability of each Party to the other Parties ... shall not exceed the greater of (a) ... and (b)"
21.3 "Under no circumstances shall any Party be liable to any other Party ... for any indirect or consequential loss or damage"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality
Uncapped carve-out for data protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: "Excluded Claims" list contains only indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud — no data protection or security limb

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: no IP infringement limb appears in the definition of "Excluded Claims"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: inserted 21.4 contains no statement that payment obligations or amounts due are excluded from 'damages'
cap is on "amounts paid or payable ... in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event" and adds the preferred-only "US$1,000,000" floor

elements.element: Carve-out for gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "a Party's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud"

reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the fee limb reads "amounts paid or payable" anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim" rather than fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim; change to 'fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim'.
Excluded Claims omits data protection and security obligations and infringement of the other Party's intellectual property; add both limbs.
No statement that Customer's payment obligations (amounts due under the Agreement) are not 'damages' for cap purposes; add a short sentence.
Fallback is not independently satisfied either, because the cap basis is 'amounts' with an event anchor and imports the preferred-only US$1,000,000 floor.
Insertion is otherwise minimal: it adds a single new subparagraph where no cap existed, leaves 21.2 and 21.3 untouched, and introduces no undefined term (Excluded Claims is defined in-line).
